properties.name: Pine Grove Rd at Twenty Five Mile Creek
properties.description:
**Oct 4, 2015: deadly.** Floodwater swept a car off Pine Grove Road at Twenty Five Mile Creek. The road was barricaded, and the car is believed to have gone around the barricade. It stalled and was carried down the creek. The driver drowned.

Location: exact (creek crossing).
Source: NWS Storm Events, law enforcement report.

properties.name: Tookie Doo Ln at Flat Branch
properties.description:
**Aug 3, 2024.** Flat Branch flowed over Tookie Doo Lane near Elgin and made the road impassable.

Location: exact (creek crossing).
Source: NWS Storm Events, public report.

properties.name: Neds Creek Rd (SC 413) at Neds Creek
properties.description:
**Aug 26, 2008 (remnants of Tropical Storm Fay).** Neds Creek flooded SC 413 near Bethune.

Location: exact (creek crossing).
Source: NWS Storm Events, SC Department of Highways report.

properties.name: Newman Rd (SC 588) near Buffalo Creek
properties.description:
**Aug 26, 2008 (remnants of Tropical Storm Fay).** Buffalo Creek flooded SC 588 near Bethune.

Location: approximate. Pinned where SC 588 crosses Little Buffalo Creek, the closest match to the report.
Source: NWS Storm Events, SC Department of Highways report.

properties.name: Downtown Camden
properties.description:
**Aug 5, 2006.** Several cars were stranded in 1 to 2 feet of water on Laurens, Rutledge and Lamden roads.

**Sep 21, 1999.** Rapid flooding in low-lying parts of Camden, with water about 2 feet deep downtown.

Location: general area (between Laurens and Rutledge streets).
Source: NWS Storm Events, emergency management and sheriff reports.

properties.name: Kirkland Street area
properties.description:
**Jun 24, 2012.** Heavy rain caused flooding and a sinkhole in the Kirkland Street area.

Location: approximate.
Source: NWS Storm Events, law enforcement report.

properties.name: Dekalb St Walmart parking lot
properties.description:
**Jun 24, 2012.** Cars were flooded out in the Walmart parking lot on Dekalb Street.

Location: approximate.
Source: NWS Storm Events, sheriff report.
